title: I Can't Find My Mom
title_zh: 找不到妈妈时怎样求助
can_do: 在家平静演练向可信任的工作人员说明找不到家长、说出名字并求助，留在服务台旁等工作人员联系家长。

conversation_move.label: ask an identifiable safe adult for help

trigger: Mom explicitly announces that she will pretend to be a store worker during a calm home rehearsal; she stays visible beside Child throughout.
setting: A calm store-worker rehearsal at a small home desk, with Mom and Child seated together and the familiar living room visible.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Let's practice. I'll be the store worker.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: You're safe here. What's your name?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: My name is Leo. Can you help me, please?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Of course. I'll call your mom now.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: We'll wait together until she comes.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Good. I like this game, Mom.

replay_cards.title: Ask a security officer
replay_cards.setting: A calm home rehearsal with Dad always visible
replay_cards.change: Dad announces that he will pretend to be the security officer at the information desk
replay_cards.challenge: Child tells Dad-as-officer, "I can't find my mom." After Dad asks his name, Child says, "My name is Leo. Can you help me, please?" Dad says they will stay at the desk while he contacts Mom. Child agrees, "I'll stay here with you," and remains seated beside Dad; no actual separation or call is staged.

replay_cards.title: Make the help request clearer
replay_cards.setting: A calm home rehearsal with Mom always visible
replay_cards.change: Mom announces her pretend park-staff role at the information desk and does not hear the first request clearly
replay_cards.challenge: Child says he cannot find his mom. Mom-as-staff calmly asks him to repeat, so he says, "I need help finding my mom." Mom asks his name; he gives only the fictional first name Leo and asks for help. Mom says she will contact his mom while they stay at the desk. Child agrees to stay with the staff member, and both remain seated at home.

parent_support: Keep this visibly a calm rehearsal at home. Mom announces her pretend worker role and stays present throughout; never hide, create real separation, frighten Child or turn the exchange into a test.

Before an outing, identify the customer-service or information desk and staff who can help, such as store employees, security officers or park staff. A badge alone does not make every person trustworthy. Practice staying with the identified worker while that worker gets help, without going outside or to a parking lot.

Leo is a fictional practice first name. The demo does not ask for or display a surname, address, phone number or other unnecessary personal details. Mom describes a pretend call; no real contact information, device, call or reunion is needed.
A small serious look is enough. Mom responds warmly at normal volume; no panic, stranger touch, dramatic crying, forced hug or celebratory rescue is part of the rehearsal.
